item.title: Table Habit v1.27.15
item.description:
Table Habit 1.27.15 | mhabit-unsigned
# Released: v1.27.15+204
## ✨ Features
- Integrate native desktop title bars and keep app bars pinned while scrolling (#677) - Fuse macOS window controls with adaptive toolbars and handle fullscreen transitions - Match native title bar colors to the app theme on Windows and Linux - Keep a manually collapsed sidebar closed across layout and interface-style changes within the current session (#679) - Restore desktop window size and position before the window first appears (#681) - Save ordinary window geometry without treating fullscreen or maximized bounds as the preferred window size
## 🐛 Fixes
- Preserve open dialogs and their state while updating theme colors, and keep dialog app bars consistent with their local theme (#677) - Restore the Settings Back button when the sidebar and its collapsed toolbar navigation are hidden (#678)
## 🧹 Others
- Add desktop native regression tests and integrate them into local and CI test workflows (#677)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/FriesI23/mhabit/compare/v1.27.13+202...v1.27.15+204)
